		FileDate_Drv = toString((substring(toString($sFileName), toInteger(locate('_', $sFileName, locate('_', $sFileName, locate('_', $sFileName, locate('_', $sFileName, 1)+1)+1)+1) + 1), toInteger(2)))) + '/' + toString((substring(toString($sFileName), toInteger(locate('_', $sFileName, locate('_', $sFileName, locate('_', $sFileName, locate('_', $sFileName, 1)+1)+1)+1) + 3), toInteger(2)))) + '/' + toString((substring(toString($sFileName), toInteger(locate('_', $sFileName, locate('_', $sFileName, locate('_', $sFileName, locate('_', $sFileName, 1)+1)+1)+1) + 5), toInteger(4)))),
		BASETHRESHPRINCIPAL_Drv = toFloat(iif(BASETHRESHPRINCIPAL == '', 0, toInteger(toFloat(BASETHRESHPRINCIPAL)))),
		BASEMINTRANSPRINCIPAL_Drv = toFloat(iif(BASEMINTRANSPRINCIPAL == '', 0, toInteger(toFloat(BASEMINTRANSPRINCIPAL)))),

		CPTYAMOUNT_Drv = toFloat(iif(CPTYAMOUNT == '', 0, toInteger(toFloat(CPTYAMOUNT)))),
		REPORTINGTHRESHPRINCIPAL_Drv = toFloat(iif(REPORTINGTHRESHPRINCIPAL == '', 0, toInteger(toFloat(REPORTINGTHRESHPRINCIPAL)))),

		BASEADJVMCOLVALHELDBYCPTY_Drv = toFloat(iif(BASEADJVMCOLVALHELDBYCPTY == '', 0, toInteger(toFloat(BASEADJVMCOLVALHELDBYCPTY)))),
		BASEADJIMCOLVALHELDBYPRINCIPAL_Drv = toFloat(iif(BASEADJIMCOLVALHELDBYPRINCIPAL == '', 0, toInteger(toFloat(BASEADJIMCOLVALHELDBYPRINCIPAL)))),
		BASEADJIMCOLVALHELDBYCPTY_Drv = toFloat(iif(BASEADJIMCOLVALHELDBYCPTY == '', 0, toInteger(toFloat(BASEADJIMCOLVALHELDBYCPTY)))),
		AGE_UNANSWERED_Drv = iif(AGE_UNANSWERED == '', 0, toInteger(AGE_UNANSWERED)),
		ISSUEDATE_Drv = iif(ISSUEDATE == '', toDate(toString(null(), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"), toDate(ISSUEDATE, "MM/dd/yyyy")),
		COB_Drv = iif(COB == '', toDate(toString(null(), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"), toDate(COB, "MM/dd/yyyy"))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of FileDate_Drv} = toDate(FileDate_Drv, "MM/dd/yyyy")) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion,LookupLKPTABLE lookup({Copy of FileDate_Drv} == fileDate,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup filter(!isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(input(

		fxRate as integer,
		reportingMinTransferCpty as double,
		agreementStatus as string,
		ageUnanswered as integer,
		principalPendingCollateralHeld as double,

		reportingCptyIa as double,

		comments as string,
		grp as string,
		principalShortName as string,

		reportingTotalExposureAmount as double,
		baseThreshCtpy as double,
		fileDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',

		counterparty as string,
		baseMinTransCtpy as double,
		cptyAmount as double,
		baseCallAmount as double,
		baseAdjVmColValHeldByPrincipal as double,
		otherJurisdiction as string

		agreementStatus = AGREEMENTSTATUS,

		issueDate = ISSUEDATE_Drv,

		lrfp = LRFP,

		grp = GRP,
		principalShortName = PRINCIPALSHORTNAME,
		externalId = EXTERNAL_ID,
		reportingTotalExposureAmount = REPORTINGTOTALEXPOSUREAMOUNT_Drv,
		baseThreshCtpy = BASETHRESHCTPY_Drv,
		fileDate = {Copy of FileDate_Drv},
		grossCalc = GROSSCALC,
		otmExposure = OTMEXPOSURE_Drv,

		marginType = MARGINTYPE,
		repAdjColValueHeldByCpty = REPADJCOLVALUEHELDBYCPTY_Drv,
